name: DOLO 650
uses: Fever and mild-to-moderate pain (headache, toothache, body ache).
dosage: Typically 1 tablet every 4-6 hours as needed; do not exceed 4 g/day. Follow the prescriber.
side_effects: Rare at normal doses; overdose can cause serious liver damage.

name: AZEE 500
uses: Bacterial infections of the throat, sinus, ear, chest, and skin.
dosage: Commonly 1 tablet once daily for 3 days, or as prescribed.
side_effects: Nausea, diarrhoea, stomach upset; rarely changes in heart rhythm.

name: CROCIN ADVANCE
side_effects: Generally well tolerated; liver toxicity in overdose.

name: NEERAL 25
uses: High blood pressure, angina, and heart-rhythm control.
dosage: Once daily, as prescribed; do not stop abruptly.
side_effects: Slow pulse, dizziness, fatigue, cold hands and feet.

name: PANTODAC 40
uses: Acid reflux, heartburn, and stomach ulcers.
dosage: 1 tablet before breakfast, typically for 2-8 weeks as prescribed.
side_effects: Headache, flatulence, diarrhoea; long-term use can lower magnesium and B12.

name: VELMOL
uses: Pain and inflammation with swelling - sprains, joint pain, dental pain.
dosage: 1 tablet twice daily after food, as prescribed.
side_effects: Stomach irritation, nausea; avoid in ulcer disease and kidney problems.
